verdict.rationale: The Agentic Feed API supports batch uploads of product data of up to 200 items per batch, and a single item can target multiple AI platforms in one request. That is real bulk capability, but the evidence shows it only for catalog-feed ingestion. Missing for 10: bulk operations beyond product feed uploads (e.g., bulk session cancels or commits, bulk payment or refund actions), bulk actions via the MCP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration of batch behavior and limits.
